name: hdldiag-marketplace
description: hdldiagZero - JSON-spec-driven SVG block diagrams of HDL/RTL designs.

plugins.name: hdldiagzero
plugins.description: Generate clean SVG block diagrams of HDL/RTL/SoC designs. Color-codes by clock domain, distinguishes AXI-MM/Lite/Stream, draws CDC blocks with split fill, omits clock/reset/JTAG/debug clutter, and validates output geometry.
